exposure: Pre-cesarean prophylactic balloon placement (PBP) in the internal iliac artery
outcome: Amount of transfused red blood cells
cohort: 42 women with pernicious placenta previa who underwent cesarean delivery
finding: Pre-cesarean PBP in the internal iliac artery was a safe and effective treatment that could reduce the incidence of both postpartum hemorrhage and hysterectomy among women with pernicious placenta previa.
mod_finding: Pre-cesarean prophylactic balloon placement (PBP) in the internal iliac artery was a safe and effective treatment that could reduce the incidence of both postpartum hemorrhage and hysterectomy among women with pernicious placenta previa.
